title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 639  An Act Converting the Dr. Ramon De Santos Barangay High School in the Municipality of Cuyapo, Province of Nueva Ecija, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Dr. Ramon De Santos National High School and Appropriating Funds

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Dr. Ramon De Santos Barangay tại Thị trấn Cuyapo, Tỉnh Nueva Ecija thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Dr. Ramon De Santos Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Dr. Ramon De Santos Barangay ในเทศบาล Cuyapo จังหวัด Nueva Ecija เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Dr. Ramon De Santos แห่งชาติ

text.en:
The Dr. Ramon de Santos Barangay High School in the Municipality of Cuyapo, Province of
Nueva Ecija, is converted into a national high school to be known as the Dr. Ramon de Santos National High

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 24, 1983
